name: Lolikov Banra
source:
Mad Soviet scientist, who was sincerely serving Katerina. [spoiler]The founder of cloning technology and the creator of "star army of clones".[/spoiler] Has young appearance due to remodeling his body. Actually 65 years old. He's lolicon's principle is "not to touch, but to aesthetically appreciate". Moreover, he is a masochist. Would like to visit the a public swimming pool during the school summer vacation, but he is too sun-sensitive.

"Hahahahaha. Yes, please, praise me more!" — Lolikov in response to loli's word abuse.
